subject: Sticky bars get their own compositing layer (WebKit repaints the page per scroll frame otherwise)
body: seg12 measured 25-30% scroll fps loss on WebKit from sticky bars without a layer. Owners add the Tailwind class will-change-transform (or transform-gpu) to their sticky/fixed bars when next touching the file: AppShell.tsx:171 (seg03 — lead will assign), ReaderPage (seg06), ExamPage (seg09, include in your rework), ReviewPage (seg10, include in S10f). QuestionPage done (seg08, 7ee0916). Screenshot to confirm nothing shifts.
